# gws CLI: Events +renew helper

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the `+renew` helper for Workspace Events: renew or reactivate subscriptions (`--name`, `--all`, `--within`), with the real operational advice — subscriptions expire if not renewed, and `--all` plus a cron job keeps them alive. Companion to `googleworkspace-cli-gws-events`, not a duplicate — the narrow lifecycle command vs the full API reference, same helper pattern as the lot 33 `gws-calendar` / `gws-calendar-insert` pair. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
